mapper.select: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND engine='InnoDB'

SELECT CONCAT(table_name,'|',GROUP_CONCAT(column_name ORDER BY seq_in_index SEPARATOR ',')) AS contract_key FROM information_schema.statistics WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND non_unique=0 GROUP BY table_name,index_name

SELECT CONCAT(table_name,'|',column_name) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='quant_strategy_runtime_lease' AND column_name='lease_epoch' AND data_type='bigint' AND is_nullable='NO'

SELECT CONCAT(table_name,'|',column_name) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='quant_strategy_entry_guard' AND column_name='guard_type' AND data_type='varchar' AND is_nullable='NO'

SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='quant_protection_order' AND column_name IN ('strategy_id','strategy_instance_id') AND data_type='bigint'
SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='quant_strategy_position_state' AND column_name='maximum_return_rate' AND data_type='decimal'

SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='quant_order' AND column_name IN ('leverage_snapshot','price_tick_size_snapshot','post_fill_wallet_balance','post_fill_balance_at','post_fill_balance_requested_at')

SELECT CONCAT(table_name,'|',column_name) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND data_type='varchar' AND character_maximum_length=36 AND ((table_name='quant_strategy_pre_dispatch_intent' AND column_name='position_cycle_key') OR (table_name='quant_strategy_order_intent' AND column_name='position_cycle_key'))
